Only groups 1 and 4 are written: on a held-out half of the 4,107 records carrying an Open Food Facts NOVA value, this method reaches 96.5% precision on group 1 and 98.1% on group 4, while groups 2 and 3 could not be separated from each other above 51% and are left null.
